arabic text: AYE RAAT NA DHALNA KE UJAD JAYEGI ZAINAB
english translation text: O NIGHT DO NOT FADE, ZAINAB WILL BE DESTROYED

arabic text: BHAI SE DAME SUBH BICHAR JAYEGI ZAINAB
english translation text: ZAINAB WILL BE TORN AWAY FROM HER BROTHER AT DAWN

arabic text: SONE DE SAKINA KO KE PHIR SO NA SAKEGI
english translation text: LET SAKINA SLEEP SHE WILL NOT BE BE ABLE TO SLEEP LATER

arabic text: RONA BHI JO CHAHEGI TO PHIR RO NA SAKEGI
english translation text: EVEN IF SHE WANTS TO SHE WILL NOT BE ALLOWED TO CRY

arabic text: ASGHAR SE MULAQAT TO PHIR HO NA SAKEGI
english translation text: SHE WILL NEVER SEE ASGHAR AGAIN

arabic text: GHABRAE HUWE LAAL HAI SAHMI HUI MAAYAIN
english translation text: CHILDREN ARE ANXIOUS, MOTHERS ARE DISILLUSIONED

arabic text: JEE BHAR KE MAIN DE LOO ALI AKBAR KO DUAE
english translation text: LET ME GIVE HEARTFELT DUAS TO ALI AKBAR

arabic text: LENA HAI ABHI AUNO- MOHAMMAD KI BALAYE
english translation text: I HAVE YET TO ACCEPT THE CALAMITY OF AUN AND MUHAMMAD

arabic text: HAR CHAND SE BACHON KI ABHI PYAS HAI BAQI
english translation text: THE INNOCENT CHILDREN ARE STILL THIRSTY

arabic text: KUCH ANKH ME HASRAT TO KUCH AAS HAI BAQI
english translation text: THE EYES STILL WISH AND HOPE (FOR WATER) REMAINS

arabic text: LEKIN MERA BHAI MERA BHAI MERA ABBAS HAI BAQI
english translation text: BECAUSE MY BROTHER ABBAS IS STILL ALIVE

arabic text: AYE RAAT BIKHAR TERE BAS ME HAI JAHA TAK
english translation text: O NIGHT SCATTER AWAY AS FAR AS YOU CAN

arabic text: MIT JAAYE KAL ALE PAYMABAR KE NISHAN TAK
english translation text: (FOR) TOMORROW ALL SIGNS OF THE PROPHET WILL BE WIPED OFF

arabic text: BAQI HAI YE MANZAR ALI AKBAR KI AZAAN TAK
english translation text: THIS SCENE WILL ONLY REMAIN TILL ALI AKBAR'S ADHAAN

arabic text: BAQI HAI ABHI AALE MOHAMMAD KA SAFINA
english translation text: THE SHIP OF AHLE BAIT(HUSSAIN) IS STILL ALIVE

arabic text: BETI KO SULANE KA HAI SHABBIR KA SINA
english translation text: SHABBIR'S BOSOM IS STILL THERE FOR SAKINA TO REST

arabic text: JHOOLA ALI ASGHAR KA JHULATI HAI SAKINA
english translation text: SAKINA IS ROCKING ALI ASGHAR'S CRADLE

arabic text: KAL KAUN SUNEGA YE MERI AAHO BUKA BHI
english translation text: WHO WILL LISTEN TO MY PAIN AND LAMENT TOMORROW

arabic text: HOGA TAHE KHANJAR MERE BHAI KA GALA BHI
english translation text: MY BROTHER'S THROAT WILL BE ON THE EDGE OF THE SWORD

arabic text: KHAIMA TO KUJA SAR PE NA HOGI YE RIDA BHI
english translation text: THE TENTS WILL BE GONE AND MY HIJAB TOO

arabic text: AYE RAAT GHARI BHAR KO TO RAHNE DE SUKOON MAIN
english translation text: O NIGHT LEAVE US IN PEACE FOR A WHILE

arabic text: GHIR JAYENGE NASIR MERE AADA KI SAFON MEEN
english translation text: MY HELPERS WILL BE SURROUNDED BY THE RANKS OF THE ENEMY

arabic text: YE CHAND SE CHEHRE TO NAHA JAYENGE KHOON MEEN
english translation text: THEIR INNOCENT FACES WILL BE DRENCHED IN BLOOD

arabic text: AY RAAT NA DHALNA KE UJAR JAYEGI ZAINAB\nBHAI SE DAM E SUBH BICHAR JAYEGI ZAINAB\nAY RAAT NA DHALNA KE UJAR JAYEGI ZAINAB
english translation text: OH NIGHT, DO NOT SET FOR ZAINAB WILL BE DESTROYED\nIN THE WAKE OF DAWN, ZAINAB AND HER BROTHER WILL BE SEPARATED

arabic text: SONE DE SAKINA KO KE PHIR SO NA SAKEGI\nRONA BHI JO CHAHEGI TO PHIR RO NA SAKEGI\nASGHAR SE MULAKAAT TO PHIR HO NA SAKEGI
english translation text: LET SAKEENA SLEEP FOR SHE WILL NOT BE ABLE TO SLEEP.\nSHE WILL NOT BE ABLE TO CRY EVEN IF SHE WANTED TO\nSHE WILL NOT BE ABLE TO MEET ALI ASGHAR

arabic text: GHABRAYE HUYE LAAL HAI SEHMI HUI MAYEIN\nJEE BHAR KE MAI DE LON ALI AKBAR KO DUAYEIN\nLENA HAI ABHI AUN O MOHAMAD KI BALAYEIN
english translation text: THE CHILDREN ARE TERRIFIED AND THE MOTHERS ARE SCARED\nLET ME GIVE AS MANY BLESSINGS TO AKBAR AS I CAN\nLET ME TAKE ANY AUN AND MOHAMMAD’S MISFORTUNE UPON MYSELF.

arabic text: AE RAAT BIKHAR JA TERE BAS MAY HO JAHAN TAK\nMIT JAYENGE KAL AAL E PAYAMBER KE NISHAN TAK\nBAAQI HAI YEH MANZAR ALI AKBAR KI AZAN TAK
english translation text: OH NIGHT SPREAD YOUR DARKNESS AS MUCH AS IS IN YOUR CAPACITY\nFOR EVEN THE TRACES OF ALE MUHAMMED WILL BE ERASED\nTHEY WILL ONLY REMAIN TILL THE AZAAN OF ALI AKBAR

arabic text: BAAQI HAI ABHI AAL E MUHAMAD KA SAFEENA\nBETI KE SULANE KO HAI SHABBIR KA SEENA\nJHOOLA ALI ASGHAR KA JHULAATI HAI SAKINA
english translation text: THE SHIP OF THE AHLULBAYTIS STILL SAILING\nTHE CHEST OF IMAM HUSSAIN IS STILL THERE FOR SAKINA TO SLEEP\nFOR NOW, SAKEENA IS SWINGING THE CRADLE OF ALI ASGHAR

arabic text: KAL KAUN SUNEGA YE MERI AAH O BUKA BHI\nHOGA TAHE KHANJAR MERE BHAI KA GALA BHI\nKHEMA TO KUJA SAR PE NA HOGI YE RIDA BHI
english translation text: WHO WILL LISTEN TO MY CRIES TOMORROW\nAS MY BROTHER’S NECK WILL BE UNDER THE DAGGER\nLET ALONE THE TENTS, THERE WILL BE NO HIJAB ON OUR HEADS

arabic text: AE RAAT GHADI BHAR KO TU REHNE DE SAKOON MAY\nGHIR JAYENGE NASIR MERE AADA KI SAFON MAY\nYEH CHAND SE CHEHRE TO NAHA JAYENGE KHOON MAY
english translation text: OH NIGHT FOR A MOMENT JUST STAY STILL\nBECAUSE MY PROTECTORS WILL BE SURROUNDED BY THE ENEMIES\nAND THEIR MOON-LIKE FACES WILL BE DRENCHED IN BLOOD
